title: Incremental tool contract format: JSON schema for partial-validation and graceful errors
creator: Aditi Rao
description: Problem: We lack a single, backward-compatible JSON schema format and runtime behavior for tool/function calls that supports incremental (streaming) validation, clear error classes for SDKs, and compatibility layers across model/runtime versions. This ticket proposes a compact JSON contract format, runtime validation modes (strict, permissive, incremental), and a standardized error envelope that SDKs and the Console can use for diagnostics and remediation suggestions. Goals: 1) Define a JSON manifest that is compact, extendable, and versioned. 2) Specify per-parameter validation semantics including coercion rules, defaulting, and streaming partial-acceptance for long-running/streaming outputs. 3) Define an error taxonomy (validation, runtime, transient, compatibility) with stable codes and suggested remediations. 4) Provide a compatibility shim strategy so older SDKs and models can interoperate with newer schema features. 5) Outline telemetry hooks to measure validation failures, autocorrections, and platform-side fallbacks.
notes: High-level design decisions: - Use a single top-level 'contract_version' field and a small feature bitmap for optional behaviors. - Parameters defined as an array of entries rather than a nested object to enable streaming validation and partial acceptance. - Validation modes: 'strict' (reject on first violation), 'permissive' (coerce when possible and attach warnings), 'incremental' (accept prefixes for streamed values and emit partial validation events). - Error envelope fields: code, span (token range or param name), severity, human_message, suggested_fix, compatible_fallback. - SDKs expose a ValidationResult structure and opt into 'permissive' by default for host apps that prefer leniency. - Telemetry: emit events for validation_failure, coercion_applied, fallback_used, and contract_version_mismatch.
acceptance_criteria: Schema V1 documented with examples for primitives, arrays, nested objects, enums, and file handles
Runtime implements strict/permissive/incremental modes and emits unified error envelopes
SDKs (python/node) map engine error codes to ValidationResult and surface coercions as warnings
Compatibility shim doc describing 'feature_bitmap' and fallbacks for older runtimes
Telemetry events emitted and dashboard tile in Console showing validation failure trends
implementation_plan: Draft contract JSON schema and short examples (this ticket)
Design review with API/SDK and Console teams
Runtime implementation: parser + validation pipeline + incremental API hooks
SDK patching: client-side prevalidation & mapping to friendly exceptions/warnings
End-to-end test harness with model-generated tool calls and intentional malformed inputs
Rollout: opt-in 'permissive' default behind feature flag, monitor telemetry for 2 weeks, then flip default
